quotes.text: II. CHASE-LLOYD HOUSE, 22 Maryland Avenue. (Open 10-12 and 2-4). A rare ex- ample of a three-story Georgian mansion, this impressive house was started in 1769 by- Samuel Chase, one of Maryland's four signers. He sold the property to Edward Lloyd of Wye House on the Eastern Shore who finished it in 1772. Lloyd's enormous wealth made possible the elegance of the interior. The carved detail is exquisite. Especially noteworthy are a magnificent Palladian window over the landing and finely wrought silver door-knobs.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026 from the WP-11.1 research pass; a new exemplar on mid-atlantic-georgian, the three-storey Annapolis brick house across the street from the Hammond-Harwood House. The survey's written data is two short 1930s-40 entries with no dimensions; the 25 photographs and the measured drawings are where the figures live.
